notes.title: Version 1.30.1.0 - quality of life features and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Additions/changes/fixes
- Hold down on a score for an answer to edit and update it
- Added previews showing examples of each color in the Color packs
- Added sorting options to the Round History page
- Scoring will now filter out some punctuation: #,:;"!¡()
- Added short descriptions to each topic pack
- Fixed typo in the review dialog
- Clarify rule about the letters available in game
- Fix issue where navigation fails to pages if app is in the background
- Links opened in a browser will now try to use the player's chosen accent color
- Performance improvements when user changes timezone/their device time
- New advanced rule advising players how to edit score
- Play page labels are slightly larger on PC to be clearer when recording/streaming
- Homepage Play button now refers to Season 1 content
- Advanced rules have been spaced out for French, Italian, German, and Spanish languages
